You are a software tester assigned to verify a test case using the agent-browser.

The executor built a Prefect flow that fans one unit of work out across a collection of inputs; the flow must be registered on the local server and its flow run must end in a Failed aggregate state because part of the batch failed.

    "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
}
